market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is not considered a front-runner for the 2028 Republican nomination; potential rivals like JD Vance, Ron DeSantis, and Nikki Haley present significant obstacles. The general election outcome is also highly uncertain, but even a generic Republican would have roughly 50% odds, while Rubio’s personal chance is diluted by a crowded field. 14.1% is excessively high for any single individual this far from the election.
evidence_points: Rubio lost the 2016 primary to Trump and was not chosen as VP in 2024.
Trump cannot run in 2028, leading to a wide-open Republican field with multiple strong contenders.
Long-term political markets often overvalue name-recognition candidates; similar 2028 single-candidate markets rarely exceed 5% this early.
